title: Add support for GitLab CI integration
body:
It would be great if Canon could work with GitLab CI pipelines in addition to GitHub Actions. We use GitLab at our company and would love to use Canon's spec-driven workflows.

Specifically:
- A `.gitlab-ci.yml` template that runs spec-lint and verify
- Support for GitLab merge request comments (coverage delta)
- Integration with GitLab issues for ticket sync

We have about 50 specs and 10 active developers.
